history.summary: FLAG - NOT A CONFIRMED HINDU TEMPLE: no web source documents any Hindu temple named "Nengkong Temple". Nengkong is a tourist village and natural attraction about 14 km north of Baghmara in South Garo Hills, Meghalaya, known for its long limestone caves (Tetengkol Balwakol, ~5.3 km, one of the longest in the Indian subcontinent; Dobakkol Chibe Nala, ~2 km; Bok-bak dobakkol), the Chibe river, and Garo tribal culture - keep-or-drop decision needed for a Hindu-temples dataset. The area is agricultural (organic vegetables on the Chibe river bank) and is served by Nengkong Baptist Church, confirming the local population is predominantly Christian. The CSV row appears to misclassify a natural/cave tourism site as a temple. CSV town "Baghmara" is the nearest town, not the site's location: Nengkong village is ~14-25 km north of Baghmara, near Emangre.

name: Nengkong (CSV row name: Nengkong Temple)
town_description: Baghmara is the district headquarters of South Garo Hills, Meghalaya, on the Bangladesh border, about 113 km from Tura. It is the gateway to Siju Cave, the Pitcher Plant Sanctuary, and the Nengkong cave area ~14 km to the north.
tradition: Not a Hindu temple - natural/cave tourism site in the Garo Hills (local religious presence is Baptist Christian); keep-or-drop decision needed.

travel.airport: Guwahati Airport is about 211 km away (per Meghalaya Tourism); Shillong Airport about 287 km.
travel.railway: No railway station nearby - the nearest major station is Guwahati, Assam.
travel.road: Reach Baghmara by road from Guwahati/Tura, then hire local taxis/4x4 via Emangre; Nengkong is about 14-25 km north of Baghmara. Roads beyond the main highway are rough and remote.

visitor_information.best_time: October to April; post-monsoon late September to November is ideal. Avoid June-September monsoon (landslides, flooding).
visitor_information.opening_hours: Natural site - accessible year-round; hire local guides for cave exploration (verify locally). Note: coordinates are approximate (map-pin level for Nengkong village area) - verify on ground.
